title: KnowBias: Mitigating Social Bias in LLMs via Know-Bias Neuron Enhancement
reasoning: The paper explicitly includes 'religion' as one of its three primary demographic dimensions for identifying 'know-bias' neurons and evaluating debiasing performance across multiple benchmarks. It also utilizes 'normative judgment' questions to probe the model's ability to recognize the moral and social inappropriateness of biased beliefs.
